svg.title: Lucas Heffner — Author platform
svg.desc: Author platform for Lucas Heffner and Up Armor Publishing, with the Cut the Crap book, resources, community and a store. Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Motion, Express. Live at lucas-heffner.vercel.app. Last updated Sep 9, 2026.
